name: Coastal Automotive
old_description: Coastal Automotive leverages innovation, precision, industry-leading resources and rapid development and production capabilities to transform your energy management challenges into solutions.
about:
Coastal Automotive, headquartered in Holland, Michigan, was founded in 2007 as a manufacturer of passive energy management solutions for the mobility sector. The company operates additional manufacturing facilities in Rochester Hills, Michigan, and maintains sales and engineering offices in Seoul and Tokyo. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces energy-absorbing components using proprietary foam materials—IMPAXX™ and TereSorb™—through processes that include die cutting, vacuum and cold forming, compression molding, CNC wire cutting, and 3D printing for customized parts. It offers CAE services, product development, and assembly, with a stated capability to move from prototype to high-volume production without traditional tooling.

Coastal Automotive serves automotive OEMs, motorsports (including NASCAR, for which it is the premier energy management provider), heavy-truck, marine, and aftermarket customers. Its Michigan headquarters sits near the North American operations of a dozen OEMs, and its global offices support customers across time zones.

The company emphasizes sustainability, recycling 100 percent of unused foam scrap into polystyrene-based products and crafting TereSorb from 100 percent recycled bottles. It operates under Six Sigma and Lean disciplines, holds ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 certifications, and has earned multiple GM Supplier of the Year awards.
